scientific_integrity: Proof and exact rational replay provided; finite calculations corroborate but do not prove the asymptotic limit.
scientific_limitations: The logarithmic asymptotic requires a fixed number of layers and each layer size bounded below by a positive fraction of the dimension; no global monotonicity or sharp crossover index is asserted. Historical priority requires independent checking.
title: Covariance determinants and a below-cube isotropic crossover for layered chain polytopes
